report:
Reviewed the entire meta.contracts.correspondence claim, both associated implementation files (correspondence.rs and workspace.rs), and all eleven associated tests. This is source inspection; no tests were executed by this reviewer, and coordinator-run suite results are separate.

CorrespondenceIndex::validate builds required units for crate/module headers, named types/classes and each explicitly declared class method. document_namespace uses the modeled crate header and nearest enclosing modeled crate for module documents. Every required unit must have at least one indexed Rust site; every annotation is checked in reverse for its containing Cargo package owner, existing Sage target and compatible namespace/type/operation category. Module markers are allowed as source evidence while executable remains false; runtime lookup only accepts executable sites in the exact matching callable region. Site vectors allow multiple source locations and preserve textual cfg conditions without evaluating execution. Cargo metadata supplies package ownership and target roots/names, independent of filesystem spelling or customized Rust target names. Rust source extraction follows inline and explicit out-of-line module paths, records supported declarations and rejects misplaced/conditional correspondence attributes instead of silently dropping them.

The exact supported define_kind_symbols adapter parses structural declarations, the placeholder enum and both enum-family groups and marks their locations as macro input; arbitrary invocation token bodies are recorded as opaque rather than inspected as declarations. Captured generator syntax confirms the structural families the adapter is intended to recognize. Captured fixture index/model/VALID helpers construct actual RustSource and parsed Sage documents with independently named Rust declarations, so mapping assertions exercise the real extraction/validation paths.

All associated tests were assessed individually. maps_independently_named_rust_declarations_and_checks_both_directions validates the complete fixture and asserts operation identity, distinct Rust method path/kind/line, exact-file lookup and crate marker naming. deletion_dangling_targets_wrong_crates_and_wrong_kinds_fail checks removed evidence, unknown targets, foreign ownership, function-versus-type incompatibility, unqualified names and malformed argument syntax. module_headers_require_correspondence_in_addition_to_the_crate_header proves an explicit module is a separate required unit and asserts exactly one missing-module error after deletion. markers_are_source_coverage_not_executable_coverage accepts module markers for all units but asserts no executable site and failed runtime lookup. multiple_cfg_sites_preserve_conditions_without_claiming_active_build_coverage requires two sites with their respective conditions and the correct nested function lookup. cargo_owner_covers_both_library_and_binary_and_explicit_nested_module_paths creates a real Cargo fixture with differing package/library/binary names and an explicit nested module path, asserting file, target identities and absolute-path operation lookup.

annotations_on_unsupported_nodes_cannot_silently_disappear requires two placement/spelling diagnostics. conditional_mappings_cannot_silently_pass_reverse_validation checks direct/nested conditional Sage mappings and conditional module paths while accepting unrelated cfg_attr. known_symbol_generator_is_parsed_but_arbitrary_macro_tokens_are_not_anchors asserts the known generated sites are marked macro_input and an arbitrary macro's fake declaration is absent. known_generator_accepts_unconditional_mapping_and_unrelated_cfg_attr checks a positive known-generator case, no diagnostics and preserved cfg. generated_declarations_reject_hidden_or_misspelled_correspondences exercises four declaration positions against four problematic attribute forms, requiring exactly one appropriate diagnostic whose source span equals the offending attribute.

Together these cover the claim's explicit verification matrix: missing/dangling/wrong-crate/incompatible sites, multiple locations, abstract module markers, Cargo library/binary ownership, supported generated declarations and exclusion of arbitrary macro token evidence. The distinction between source coverage and runtime execution is preserved in both implementation and assertions. There are no associated TODO or N/A entries. No concrete defect or additional necessary source change was found; requested edits are empty.
